_comment: Fallback FX table, units of currency per 1 USD. scripts/fetch_fx.py overwrites data/generated/fx_live.json daily from frankfurter.app; the builder prefers live and falls back to this. AED is pegged at 3.6725 and does not move.

uae_market._comment: Expected AED shelf price = USD price x AED/USD x (1 + uplift). Uplift covers 5% VAT plus importer/distributor margin. Tune per tier once you verify real Ounass / Sephora ME / Bloomingdale's prices — the gap between derived and observed is the single most useful output of this dashboard.
uae_market.note: Boutique-operated brands (Aesop, Le Labo, Diptyque, Rituals) tend to price closer to parity. Distributor-fed brands and department-store-only brands tend to run well above it. Flag anything over +30% as a pricing-power signal or a grey-market risk.
